# filmopen_app

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

A desktop browser for **FilmOpen projects**: a folder of plain JSON files that describes a film completely (characters, outfits, locations, props, styles, the script as folders and scenes, shots, cues, models, platforms, plugins, render batches, commentary and official pointers). Every entity is a versioned file per author, can be forked, and an `_official.json` pointer names the version the project has chosen. See [docs/FilmOpen-Project-Specification v1.0.md](docs/FilmOpen-Project-Specification%20v1.0.md). How the application itself is built is in [docs/software/](docs/software/index.md) (the Software Specification, in parts, with a generated page per package), and what each milestone delivered and decided is in `docs/FilmOpen-Milestone *.md`.

**Flutter.** 6 files, 1,341 lines under `lib/`; 321 tests in 35 files. The application: no barrel; `lib/main.dart` wires the packages together.

## Files

### `lib/app.dart`

- **class `FilmOpenApp`**
  - `const FilmOpenApp({super.key})`
- **class `DraftsBeforeExit`** — Closing the window writes every open draft before the app exits (milestone 4.6, item 4): the forms show no save status, so a change typed a moment before closing must not be lost to the 700 ms debounce.
  - `const DraftsBeforeExit({super.key, required this.child})`
  - `final Widget child`
  - `static const Duration limit` — How long the drafts are waited for before the app exits anyway.
- **class `_DraftsBeforeExitState`**

### `lib/consts.dart`

- **variable** `const String kAppVersion` — Must match `version:` in pubspec.yaml; the About dialog shows it.
- **variable** `const String kSpecUrl`
- **variable** `const String kAppBuild` — The CI run that made this build (`--dart-define=FILMOPEN_BUILD`), `dev` for any other (the bug-tracking plan's Part B.1).
- **variable** `const String kAppCommit` — The commit CI built (`FILMOPEN_COMMIT`), `local` for any other build (B.1).
- **variable** `const String kAppBuiltAt` — When this build was made, an instant in UTC to the second (`FILMOPEN_BUILT_AT`, which every script that builds or runs the app passes); empty in a build made without one.

### `lib/main.dart`

- **function** `Future<void> main(List<String> arguments)` — [arguments] is the command line: on Windows the runner passes it on (`windows/runner/main.cpp`), and a browser's account sign-in callback arrives this way when the app was not running (`filmopen_account`'s `account_ca…
- **function** `Future<void> _startLog()` — Opens the log before anything else can fail: a file in the platform's log folder (see `filmopen_platform`'s `app_paths.dart`), the console in debug builds, and every uncaught Flutter or Dart error routed into it.
- **function** `void _registerMediaSources()` — The media sources this build knows, beyond the local folder that is built in (D1, D2).
